answer: Identity registration through a trellis of cross-staked bonds: each agent bonds to vouch for a newcomer, forming an interlocked lattice. The registry traces each fake back along the trellis and slashes the whole branch. An attacker raising a dune of puppets funds one bond per vouch, so 10,000 fakes cost 10,000 stakes at risk. Onboarding is a velvet path for one honest agent, but mass forgery locks capital that burns on detection.
